name: app-skullStrip
summary: Skull-strips a T1-weighted image with AFNI 3dSkullStrip, optionally passing extra 3dSkullStrip options, and outputs the brain-extracted T1w.
description: Runs AFNI 3dSkullStrip on the input T1w NIfTI (with a virtual X display) and writes the result as t1.nii.gz. Extra command-line options can be given verbatim in optional_params. Use it as a simple brain-extraction step; check the result visually, as the README notes the skull may not be fully removed.

parameters.description:
add all optional parameters here, in the format below:

-parameter option -parameter2 

if no optional parameters needed, leave empty. for a full list of optional parameters and what they do, see AFNI's documentation: https://afni.nimh.nih.gov/pub/dist/doc/program_help/3dSkullStrip.html

examples:

-ld 30 -no_spatnorm

-niter 750 -ld 50

-monkey -spatnorm_dxyz

citations.text: Avesani P et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).
